1.english_reference: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said

traditions.WLC: וַ֭ יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽ תֵּימָנִ֗י וַ יֹּאמַֽר
traditions.LXX: Ὑπολαβὼν δὲ Ἐλειφὰς ὁ Θαιμανείτης λέγει
traditions.VUL: Respóndens autem Eliphaz Themanítes , dixit :
traditions.KJV: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said ,

2.english_reference: If we assay to commune with thee , wilt thou be grieved ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ נִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣י ךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Μὴ πολλάκις σοι λελάληται ἐν κόπῳ ;
traditions.VUL: Si cœpérimus loqui tibi , fórsitan moléste accípies ,
traditions.KJV: [ If ] we assay to commune with thee , wilt thou be grieved ?

2.english_reference: but who can withhold himself from speaking ?

traditions.WLC: וַ עְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝ מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל
traditions.LXX: ἰσχὺν δὲ ῥημάτων σου τίς ὑποίσει ;
traditions.VUL: sed concéptum sermónem tenére quis póterit ?
traditions.KJV: but who can withhold himself from speaking ?

traditions.LXX: εἰ γὰρ σὺ ἐνουθέτησας πολλούς ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce docuísti multos ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , thou hast instructed many ,

3.english_reference: and thou hast strengthened the weak hands

traditions.LXX: καὶ χεῖρας ἀσθενοῦς παρεκάλεσας ,
traditions.VUL: et manus lassas roborásti :
traditions.KJV: and thou hast strengthened the weak hands .

4.english_reference: Thy words have upholden him that was falling

traditions.LXX: ἀσθενοῦντάς τε ἐξανέστησας ῥήμασιν ,
traditions.VUL: vacillántes confirmavérunt sermónes tui ,
traditions.KJV: Thy words have upholden him that was falling ,

4.english_reference: and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees

traditions.LXX: γόνασίν τε ἀδυνατοῦσιν θάρσος περιέθηκας ·
traditions.VUL: et génua treméntia confortásti :
traditions.KJV: and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees .

5.english_reference: But now it is come upon thee , and thou faintest

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣י ךָ וַ תֵּ֑לֶא
traditions.LXX: νῦν δὲ ἥκει ἐπὶ σὲ πόνος καὶ ἥψατό σου , σὺ ἐσπούδασας .
traditions.VUL: nunc autem venit super te plaga , et defecísti :
traditions.KJV: But now it is come upon thee , and thou faintest ;

5.english_reference: it toucheth thee , and thou art troubled

traditions.VUL: tétigit te , et conturbátus es .
traditions.KJV: it toucheth thee , and thou art troubled .

6.english_reference: Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְ ךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְ ךָ֗ וְ תֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: πότερον οὐχ ὁ φόβος σού ἐστιν ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ , καὶ ἡ ἐλπίς σου καὶ ἡ κακία τῆς ὁδοῦ σου ;
traditions.VUL: Ubi est timor tuus , fortitúdo tua , patiéntia tua , et perféctio viárum tuárum ?
traditions.KJV: [ Is ] not [ this ] thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?

7.english_reference: Remember , I pray thee , who ever perished , being innocent ?

traditions.WLC: זְכָר נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: μνήσθητι οὖν τίς καθαρὸς ὢν ἀπώλετο ,
traditions.VUL: Recordáre , óbsecro te , quis unquam ínnocens périit ?
traditions.KJV: Remember , I pray thee , who [ ever ] perished , being innocent ?

7.english_reference: or where were the righteous cut off ?

traditions.LXX: ἢ πότε ἀληθινοὶ ὁλόριζοι ἀπώλοντο ;
traditions.VUL: aut quando recti deléti sunt ?
traditions.KJV: or where were the righteous cut off ?

8.english_reference: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְ זֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καθ᾽ ὃν τρόπον ἴδον τοὺς ἀροτριῶντας τὰ ἄτοπα · οἱ δὲ σπείροντες αὐτὰ ὀδύνας θεριοῦσιν ἑαυτοῖς
traditions.VUL: Quin pótius vidi eos , qui operántur iniquitátem , et séminant dolóres , et metunt eos ,
traditions.KJV: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same .

9.english_reference: By the blast of God they perish

traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ προστάγματος Κυρίου ἀπολοῦνται ,
traditions.VUL: flante Deo perísse ,
traditions.KJV: By the blast of God they perish ,

9.english_reference: and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵ ר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣ וֹ יִכְלֽוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ δὲ πνεύματος ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ ἀφανισθήσονται .
traditions.VUL: et spíritu iræ eius esse consúmptos :
traditions.KJV: and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .

10.english_reference: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken

traditions.WLC: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְ ק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְ שִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ
traditions.LXX: σθένος λέοντος , φωνὴ δὲ λεαίνης , γαυρίαμα δὲ δρακόντων ἐσβέσθη .
traditions.VUL: rugítus leónis , et vox leǽnæ , et dentes catulórum leónum contríti sunt .
traditions.KJV: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .

11.english_reference: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey

traditions.LXX: μυρμηκολέων ὤλετο παρὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν βοράν ,
traditions.VUL: Tigris périit , eo quod non habéret prædam ,
traditions.KJV: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey ,

11.english_reference: and the stout lion ’s whelps are scattered abroad

traditions.LXX: σκύμνοι δὲ λεόντων ἔλιπον ἀλλήλους .
traditions.VUL: et cátuli leónis dissipáti sunt .
traditions.KJV: and the stout lion ’s whelps are scattered abroad .

12.english_reference: Now a thing was secretly brought to me

traditions.LXX: εἰ δέ τι ῥῆμα ἀληθινὸν ἐγεγόνει ἐν λόγοις σου , οὐθὲν ἄν σοι τούτων κακὸν ἀπήντησεν .
traditions.VUL: Porro ad me dictum est verbum abscónditum ,
traditions.KJV: Now a thing was secretly brought to me ,

12.english_reference: and mine ear received a little thereof

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗ י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְ הֽוּ
traditions.LXX: πότερον οὐ δέξεταί μου τὸ οὖς ἐξαίσια παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ ;
traditions.VUL: et quasi furtíve suscépit auris mea venas susúrri eius .
traditions.KJV: and mine ear received a little thereof .

13.english_reference: In thoughts from the visions of the night

traditions.LXX: φόβος δὲ καὶ ἠχὼ ,
traditions.VUL: In horróre visiónis noctúrnæ ,
traditions.KJV: In thoughts from the visions of the night ,

13.english_reference: when deep sleep falleth on men

traditions.LXX: ἐπιπίπτων φόβος ἐπ᾽ ἀνθρώπους ,
traditions.VUL: quando solet sopor occupáre hómines ,
traditions.KJV: when deep sleep falleth on men ,

14.english_reference: Fear came upon me , and trembling

traditions.LXX: φρίκη μοι συνήντησεν καὶ τρόμος ,
traditions.VUL: pavor ténuit me , et tremor ,
traditions.KJV: Fear came upon me , and trembling ,

14.english_reference: which made all my bones to shake

traditions.LXX: καὶ μεγάλως μου τὰ ὀστᾶ διέσεισεν ,
traditions.VUL: et ómnia ossa mea pertérrita sunt :
traditions.KJV: which made all my bones to shake .

15.english_reference: Then a spirit passed before my face

traditions.WLC: וְ֭ רוּחַ עַל פָּנַ֣ י יַחֲלֹ֑ף
traditions.LXX: καὶ πνεῦμα ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπῆλθεν ,
traditions.VUL: et cum spíritus me præsénte transíret ,
traditions.KJV: Then a spirit passed before my face ;

15.english_reference: the hair of my flesh stood up

traditions.LXX: ἔφριξαν δέ μου τρίχες καὶ σάρκες .
traditions.VUL: inhorruérunt pili carnis meæ .
traditions.KJV: the hair of my flesh stood up :

traditions.LXX: ἀνέστην ,
traditions.VUL: Stetit quidam ,
traditions.KJV: It stood still ,

16.english_reference: but I could not discern the form thereof

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνων · ἴδον , καὶ οὐκ ἦν μορφὴ πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν μου ,
traditions.VUL: cuius non agnoscébam vultum ,
traditions.KJV: but I could not discern the form thereof :

16.english_reference: an image [ was ] before mine eyes

traditions.VUL: imágo coram óculis meis ,
traditions.KJV: an image [ was ] before mine eyes , [ there was ]

16.english_reference: silence , and I heard a voice

traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἢ αὔραν καὶ φωνὴν ἤκουον
traditions.VUL: et vocem quasi auræ lenis audívi :
traditions.KJV: silence , and I heard a voice , [ saying ] ,

17.english_reference: Shall mortal man be more just than God ?

traditions.LXX: Τί γάρ ; μὴ καθαρὸς ἔσται βροτὸς ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid homo Dei comparatióne iustificábitur ,
traditions.KJV: Shall mortal man be more just than God ?

17.english_reference: shall a man be more pure than his maker ?

traditions.WLC: אִ֥ם מֵ֝ עֹשֵׂ֗ הוּ יִטְהַר גָּֽבֶר
traditions.LXX: ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ἄμεμπτος ἀνήρ ;
traditions.VUL: aut factóre suo púrior erit vir ?
traditions.KJV: shall a man be more pure than his maker ?

18.english_reference: Behold , he put no trust in his servants

traditions.WLC: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭ עֲבָדָי ו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין
traditions.LXX: εἰ κατὰ παίδων αὐτοῦ οὐ πιστεύει ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce qui sérviunt ei , non sunt stábiles ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , he put no trust in his servants ;

18.english_reference: and his angels he charged with folly

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ בְ מַלְאָכָ֗י ו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה
traditions.LXX: κατὰ δὲ ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ σκολιόν τι ἐπενόησεν ·
traditions.VUL: et in ángelis suis réperit pravitátem :
traditions.KJV: and his angels he charged with folly :

19.english_reference: How much less [ in ] them that dwell in houses of clay ,

traditions.LXX: τοὺς δὲ κατοικοῦντας οἰκίας πηλίνας ,
traditions.VUL: quanto magis hi qui hábitant domos lúteas ,
traditions.KJV: How much less [ in ] them that dwell in houses of clay ,

19.english_reference: whose foundation [ is ] in the dust ,

traditions.LXX: ἐξ ὧν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐκ τοῦ αὐτοῦ πηλοῦ ἐσμεν ,
traditions.VUL: qui terrénum habent fundaméntum ,
traditions.KJV: whose foundation [ is ] in the dust , [ which ]

19.english_reference: [ which ] are crushed before the moth ?

traditions.LXX: ἔπαισεν αὐτοὺς σητὸς τρόπον .
traditions.VUL: consuméntur velut a tínea ?
traditions.KJV: are crushed before the moth ?

20.english_reference: They are destroyed from morning to evening

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ πρωίθεν μέχρι ἑσπέρας οὐκέτι εἰσίν ,
traditions.VUL: De mane usque ad vésperam succidéntur :
traditions.KJV: They are destroyed from morning to evening :

20.english_reference: they perish for ever without any regarding [ it ]

traditions.WLC: מִ בְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָ נֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ

traditions.VUL: et quia nullus intélligit , in ætérnum períbunt .
traditions.KJV: they perish for ever without any regarding [ it ] .

21.english_reference: Doth not their excellency [ which is ] in them go away ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹא נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ ם בָּ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐνεφύσησεν γὰρ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐξηράνθησαν ,
traditions.VUL: Qui autem réliqui fúerint , auferéntur ex eis :
traditions.KJV: Doth not their excellency [ which is ] in them go away ?

traditions.LXX: ἀπώλοντο
traditions.VUL: moriéntur ,
traditions.KJV: they die ,

traditions.LXX: παρὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν αὐτοὺς σοφίαν .
traditions.VUL: et non in sapiéntia .
traditions.KJV: even without wisdom .
